title: Iranian family seeks release of twin sisters facing death penalty and 25 years in prison
summary: Twin sisters Taraneh and Romina Rahimi are awaiting their sentences in Iran. They were arrested in January 2026, at the age of just 19, for taking part in protests against the Iranian regime. Taraneh is facing the death penalty, while Romina has been sentenced to 25 years in prison. Their family has been campaigning for their release.
